title: 🎬 Introducing Video Analysis in Managed Agents!
text:
Your Managed Agents can now watch, understand, and analyze videos — just like a human! 🚀
With the new Video Analysis capability, Managed Agents can analyze videos from YouTube or your Media Library, understand both visuals and audio, and provide meaningful insights.
From summarizing long webinars to extracting key moments, generating transcripts, and reviewing marketing videos, your agents can now do it all!
✨ What's New?
🎥 Built-in Video Analysis
Managed Agents can now watch and understand video content, including visuals and audio.
Generate video summaries, transcripts, and timestamped highlights.
Ask specific questions about anything shown or discussed in a video.
Automatically available to all Managed Agents with no additional setup.
🔗 YouTube & Media Library Support
Analyze videos directly from YouTube links, including Shorts and supported live video links.
Upload or attach videos from your HighLevel Media Library.
Supports popular formats including MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI, MPEG, and more.
Analyze video files up to 2 GB.
⚡ Fast & Intelligent Video Understanding
Quickly analyze long recordings without watching them manually.
Extract important conversations, topics, and key moments.
Identify specific information using timestamps.
In testing, a 24-minute video was summarized in under a minute.
🤖 AI-Powered Video Review
Review marketing videos and advertisements for content and quality.
Check whether specific visuals, logos, or messages appear.
Analyze webinars, training recordings, and customer calls.
Use video insights to generate summaries, social media content, and follow-up actions.
🔄 Works Across Agent Executions
Analyze videos directly through agent conversations.
Available during testing and triggered agent executions.
Combine Video Analysis with other Managed Agent capabilities to automate workflows.
💡 What Can You Do with Video Analysis?
Webinar Summaries: Turn long webinars into concise summaries with timestamps.
Content Repurposing: Extract key moments and ideas for social media posts.
Marketing Video Reviews: Check ads for branding, messaging, and content quality.
Meeting & Call Analysis: Generate transcripts, highlights, and action items.
Training Videos: Extract important lessons and create structured notes.
Video Quality Checks: Review generated videos before publishing.
🛠️ How to Get Started
Navigate to AI Agents → Agent Studio → Managed Agents.
Open an existing Managed Agent or create a new one.
Paste a YouTube video link or attach a video from your Media Library.
Ask your agent to analyze the video.
Example Prompts:
"Summarize this video and provide key highlights with timestamps."
"What are the main topics discussed in this webinar?"
"Create a LinkedIn post based on the key takeaways from this video."
"Review this advertisement and check whether our brand logo appears."
"Generate a transcript and identify important action items."
Your Managed Agent will analyze the video and provide the requested insights!
🎯 Why This Matters
Save Time: Understand long videos without watching them from beginning to end.
Smarter Content Creation: Turn existing video content into summaries, posts, and marketing material.
Better Quality Control: Review advertisements and generated videos before publishing.
Automated Video Workflows: Analyze videos and use the insights in subsequent agent actions.
No Additional Setup: Video Analysis is automatically available to all Managed Agents.
Cost-Effective: Token-based billing with no separate per-video fee.📢 Important Notes
Supports publicly accessible YouTube videos and supported direct video files up to 2 GB.
Unsupported video platforms and links receive a clear error message.
No additional toggle or configuration is required.
Video Analysis is billed based on token usage, with no separate per-video fee.
From watching videos to understanding content and taking action — Managed Agents just got even smarter! 🚀
